title: Quaternionic complex manifolds and fixed-point sets of $S^{1}$-actions
summary: In this paper, we study fixed-point sets of $S^{1}$-actions and compatible complex structures on quaternionic manifolds. We obtain an equation involving the first Chern classes of the fixed-point set and of a quaternionically flat manifold with compatible complex structure of closed type. In addition, if the first Chern class of the fixed-point set is not trivial, then the quaternionic manifold does not admit hypercomplex structures containing given compatible complex structure on any open set containing the fixed-point set.
